layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of subtropical coastal plains
features: Flat, expansive coastal plains under a brilliant white sun
Lush carpets of salt-tolerant ferns and thick bryophyte mosses
Scattered palm-like Bennettitales and clusters of Cycads
Clear, shallow tidal channels reflecting a saturated blue sky
Bright, humid atmosphere with high visibility to the horizon
No grass; ground is a textured sea of green fronds and moss
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, wide-angle view of a sun-drenched coastal plain. The lighting is cheerful and bright, highlighting the deep greens of the prehistoric flora against the blue water.

visuals.ground: Silty, salt-rich soil completely blanketed in a vibrant carpet of low-lying ferns and thick moss mats. No grass blades present. Soil is moist and dark where exposed.
visuals.water: Sparkling tidal pools and slow channels reflecting the zenith sun with high-contrast glints.
visuals.sky: Vibrant, deep blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds; strong, direct mid-day light.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Silty alluvium and spongy moss layers punctuated by leathery Cycad leaves.

negative_prompt: grass, lawns, meadows, prairies, snow, gloom, sunset, night, 90s CGI, grainy, humans, buildings
